22% from the previous quarter and up 62% from a year ago.
For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 73.4% and 73.6%, respectively.
For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were both $1.30.

“Compute demand keeps accelerating and compounding across training and inference — each growing exponentially.

startups, across more industries, and in more countries. AI is going everywhere, doing everything, all at once.”
